faq.lead: Can’t find your answer? Contact the team.

q1.a: A place to trade on what happens next. Pick Yes or No on a real-world question. If you’re right, each share pays 1 USDC. If not, it pays nothing.

q2.a: The price is the chance. A Yes share at 62¢ means people think there’s about a 62% chance it happens. Shares cost between 0 and 1 USDC.

q3.a: Sell your shares any time before the market closes, or keep them until the result is in and collect 1 USDC for each winning share. If a market is cancelled, each share pays 0.50 USDC. You can then withdraw to your wallet.

q4.a: You do. Your money and shares stay in your own account, linked to your wallet, and nothing is traded or withdrawn without your OK.

q5.a: Every market explains how the winner is decided before trading starts, and those rules don’t change. At launch, the Sols Market team checks the result against them. If the result is unclear, the market is cancelled and each share pays 0.50 USDC.

q6.a: Some trades have a small fee, and you see it before you confirm. Deposits, withdrawals, collecting winnings and network fees are all free.

footer.disclaimer: Prediction market trading is speculative, and you can lose the full amount you trade. Sols Market is not available in all jurisdictions. Nothing on this site is financial advice.
